messages.subject: For Yasir Al-Rumayyan | Strategic investment, government partnerships and Saudi transformation
messages.body:
Dear Public Investment Fund Media Team,

Please place this executive introduction before H.E. Yasir Al-Rumayyan, Governor.

PIF's transformation agenda across strategic sectors requires disciplined alignment across government, operating companies, international partners and long-term investment priorities. That interface closely matches the work I lead today.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead senior institutional engagement and coordinate execution across complex regulated environments.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, strategic partnerships and emerging-market execution might support PIF's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to the Public Investment Fund.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
https://ragunauthramsaroop.com/
